subject: Define artifact provider contract without concrete AST shapes
description: Add a small architecture contract for artifact decomposition providers so future PDF/doc/conversation/code/image providers can plug into the unified memory graph without forcing the AST graph implementation now. Scope is docs/schema only: create a provider-neutral contract that defines provider identity, artifact/source provenance, emitted logical nodes, relation edges, chunk/section hierarchy, idempotency expectations, and validation boundaries. Do not define concrete AST node shapes or ingestion implementation; leave code AST details to the remote AST graph workspace. Avoid touching existing causal-edge handoff schema files to reduce merge conflicts.

summary: Defined a concise provider-neutral artifact evidence contract and v1 JSON Schema, linked from the docs index, without adding runtime ingestion or concrete AST shapes.
